name: PMP22 real-work consolidation and follow-up
description: Sequential stock Hermes sessions restored explicitly from checkpoints. Inspect actual prior-work use without a comparison arm or a causal learning claim.

cases.question: Consolidate the completed PMP22 investigation for future research. Inspect its current corrected handoff, actual supporting outputs and source limitations. Verify the full record check, then save a concise searchable evidence index for useful findings, rejected and untestable hypotheses, reusable data/analyses and unresolved tests. Respect native Hermes memory scope: research results belong in the scientific archive and session history. If a useful retrieval routine emerged, use the native skill tool for a topic-scoped retrieval skill pointing to the evidence index, and verify the write. Do not invent a procedure or put scientific findings into always-on user/environment memory. No new measurements or literature collection are needed.
review_focus: Actual saved, searchable evidence index points to inspected current evidence and applicability limits; any native write is verified and appropriate to its scope
Preserves informative rejection, untestable original panel and retrospective reduced panel distinctly; no new scientific-work credit

cases.question: Can cell composition or developmental state explain the antioxidant RNA contrast observed in our prior PMP22 regulatory-system investigation? Assess useful reference data, including measurements collected for other purposes, and test this explanation where the available data support a defensible comparison. Explain how the result changes our understanding of PMP22 regulation and what remains unidentified.
cases.investigation_brief: Start a new question, retrieving the relevant prior work through persistent memory, session history or the research catalog. Inspect the underlying evidence before trusting a summary. Record which prior sources you actually retrieved, whether their biological context and exact derivation fit, which artifacts you reused, and which analysis decision the prior work informed. Assess at least one promising purified-cell or developmental-state reference for measurement and metadata suitability, including leads in the previously inspected sources. Search assay, cell-state and design terms without requiring PMP22 in the description. Compare feasible references before substantial acquisition; distinguish cell states from independent biological samples and relative proportions from absolute abundance. Preserve a falsifiable sensitivity plan before inspecting newly chosen outcomes when feasible, and label already exposed comparisons retrospective. Perform an informative analysis if possible; otherwise preserve a specific source-backed blocker and the strongest still-valid conclusion. Covariate adjustment alone is not causal proof, and sensitivity within existing data is not independent replication. Preserve old negative and untestable outcomes. Use producer-specific execution receipts for new registered computations and full schema/reference checks at handoff. Finish with explicit evidence-index consolidation, recording useful, inapplicable or corrected inherited knowledge. Respect native memory scope; a useful topic-scoped retrieval skill may point to the revisable evidence, while research conclusions stay in the scientific archive. This is one follow-up session, with no control arm; observed reuse does not establish a causal improvement from memory.
review_focus: Trace actual prior-memory/history/catalog retrieval to inspected evidence, applicability judgment, artifact reuse and a consequential analysis decision, in transcript order
Distinguish information supplied in the new prompt from independently retrieved earlier work; do not claim causal learning benefits without a comparison
Inspect reference suitability, original collection purpose, independent units, age/state/composition identifiability and actual executed sensitivities
Determine whether the new evidence challenges, preserves or leaves the prior contrast unresolved, without rescuing an untestable original panel or claiming causal NRF2 regulation
Inspect genuine retrieval receipts, new producer execution receipts, full handoff validation, searchable consolidation and any verified native-memory/skill changes within their appropriate scope
